Card Q&A.a: No, this card's effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's [All Turns] effect to digivolve it into a Digimon card with the [Beast Dragon]/[Undead]/[SoC] trait in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?
